headline: Nevish Line Swept by Colonial Flags as Mooring County Bleeds
war_summary: The map has shifted since our last edition. The Nevish Line, so long a divided march, now flies Colonial colors at every surviving post — seven to none, with an eighth base demolished — after sixty-three flag actions in the day, the latest logged at the very hour of this dispatch, and losses there remain heavy on both sides. Linn Mercy follows close with forty-two events, Outwich Ranch and Rotdust again the busiest grounds. Mooring County has rejoined the fighting in earnest: sixteen base events, The Wind Hills the storm centre, and nearly twenty-five hundred casualties a side in two hours. Callahans Passage still smoulders about Crumbling Post, though its hourly toll eased as the day closed. The Weathered Expanse has gone eight hours without a change of flag, yet two of its posts now stand in ruin and its casualty lists continue to lengthen. Stlican Shelf's flag work is paused at Briar while losses there accelerate, and Clahstra, like most other fronts, recorded no base events. It is day 775 of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
